contents: HTTP 200 and `[]`. Two bytes, verbatim and untrimmed — the emptiness is the fixture.

verification.slugIsValid: verified — the same slug returns a full 27835-byte bracket from /brackets in the same minute, so this is not the unknown-slug case docs/sources/cs2-blast.md describes

whyThisMatters: The tournament starts 2026-08-12, three days after capture, and its entire schedule exists — in /brackets only. So an empty /matches does not mean a bad slug and does not mean nothing is scheduled; for an upcoming tournament it appears to be the normal response. A forward-looking calendar cannot be built from /matches at all. See docs/sources/cs2-blast.md.
